scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./apps/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
scripts.test:routing: pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build && node --test scripts/src/api-routing.test.mjs scripts/src/platform-api.test.mjs scripts/src/workspace-api.test.mjs scripts/src/cors.test.mjs
scripts.build:web: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/startup-institution-platform run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/startup-institution-platform run build
scripts.build:api: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
